# 微软 FY26 Q4 三大业务分部完整分析报告

> **报告期**：2026 财年第四季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）
> **所有金额单位**：百万美元（$M），除特别说明外；同比增长均为与上年同期 Q4（FY25 Q4）比较
> **口径**：本报告以 GAAP  Reported 口径为主，并辅以 Constant Currency 同比口径。所有数字均可在原始文件中逐项复核。

---

## 一、总公司合计数（验证分部勾稽的基准）

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 Reported | FY25 Q4 Reported | 同比变化 | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | $90,007 | $76,441 | +18% / +17% CC | press_release.txt 第 0 行；financial_statements.txt 第 2 行 |
| 营业成本 | $29,525 | $24,014 | — | financial_statements.txt 第 6 行 |
| 经营费用（R&D + S&M + G&A） | $19,879 | $18,104 | — | financial_statements.txt 第 10–12 行 |
| **经营利润** | **$40,603** | **$34,323** | **+18%** | press_release.txt 第 0 行 |
| 经营利润率 | 45.1% | — | — | transcript.txt 第 24746 位（Amy Hood："operating margins increased slightly year-over-year to 45%"） |
| 净利润（GAAP） | $35,766 | $27,233 | +31% | press_release.txt 第 0 行 |
| 净利润（non-GAAP） | $35,286 | $28,808 | +22% | press_release.txt 第 0 行 |
| 摊薄 EPS（GAAP） | $4.81 | $3.65 | +32% | press_release.txt 第 0 行 |
| 摊薄 EPS（non-GAAP） | $4.74 | $3.86 | +23% | press_release.txt 第 0 行 |

**勾稽验证（关键步骤）**：

- 三个分部收入之和 = $37,847 + $39,306 + $12,854 = **$90,007** = 总收入 ✓
- 三个分部营业成本之和 = $6,989 + $16,876 + $5,660 = **$29,525** = 总营业成本 ✓
- 三个分部经营费用之和 = $8,958 + $6,475 + $4,446 = **$19,879** = 总经营费用 ✓
- 三个分部经营利润之和 = $21,900 + $15,955 + $2,748 = **$40,603** = 总经营利润 ✓

> 四个勾稽项全部完全一致，差异为 0，证实 press_release.txt 与 financial_statements.txt 两个文件的数据自洽。

---

## 二、分部 A：Productivity and Business Processes（生产力与商业流程）

### 2.1 关键财务指标

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | 同比变化（GAAP） | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | $37,847 | $33,112 | **+14%**（CC +14%） | press_release.txt 第 1 行；financial_statements.txt 第 3 行 |
| 营业成本 | $6,989 | $6,042 | +15.7% | financial_statements.txt 第 4 行 |
| 经营费用 | $8,958 | $8,077 | +10.9% | financial_statements.txt 第 5 行 |
| **经营利润** | **$21,900** | **$18,993** | **+15.3%** | financial_statements.txt 第 6 行 |
| **经营利润率** | **57.9%** | — | 同比上升 | transcript.txt 第 24746 位（"operating margins increased year-over-year to 58%"） |
| 毛利率 | 81.5% | — | — | 见本文计算 |

### 2.2 增长驱动因素（引用原文）

> **Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud**：来自 transcript.txt 第 24300 位："M365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 16% on an adjusted basis when normalized for the prior-year comparable that benefited from 2 points of in-period revenue recognition. On a reported basis, revenue growth was 14%." — 调整后 16% / 报告口径 14%。
>
> **M365 Consumer cloud**：来自 transcript.txt 第 24300 位："M365 consumer cloud revenue increased 24% and 22% in constant currency, again driven by ARPU growth. And M365 consumer subscriptions grew 7%."
>
> **LinkedIn**：来自 transcript.txt 第 24300 位："LinkedIn revenue increased 12% and 10% in constant currency primarily driven by Marketing Solutions."
>
> **Dynamics 365**：来自 transcript.txt 第 24300 位："Dynamics 365 revenue increased 13% and 12% in constant currency against a strong prior-year comparable. Bookings growth in ERP remains healthy, while CRM continued to moderate with longer sales cycles."
>
> **M365 Commercial Products**：来自 transcript.txt 第 24300 位："M365 Commercial products revenue increased 19%, ahead of expectations driven by large, long-duration M365 contracts that resulted in higher in-period revenue recognition from the Windows Commercial on-premises component."

> **经营利润率扩张驱动**：来自 transcript.txt 第 24746 位："Segment gross margin dollars increased 14% and 13% in constant currency. And gross margin percentage decreased slightly with increased M365 Copilot usage as we continue to invest in product quality and drive further efficiency gains. Operating expenses increased 11% primarily driven by the shared R&D investments mentioned earlier. Operating income increased 15% and 14% in constant currency."

**小结**：该分部收入同比增长 14%，主要由 M365 Commercial cloud（14%）和 M365 Consumer cloud（24%）驱动；经营利润率扩张至 57.9%，得益于 Copilot 推动的 ARPU 增长和 Premium 升级，尽管 GAAP 毛利率因 Copilot 投入略有下降，但经营费用增速（+11%）显著低于收入增速（+14%），规模效应释放。

---

## 三、分部 B：Intelligent Cloud（智能云）

### 3.1 关键财务指标

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | 同比变化（GAAP） | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | $39,306 | $29,878 | **+32%**（CC +31%） | press_release.txt 第 2 行；financial_statements.txt 第 10 行 |
| 营业成本 | $16,876 | $11,845 | +42.5% | financial_statements.txt 第 11 行 |
| 经营费用 | $6,475 | $5,893 | +9.9% | financial_statements.txt 第 12 行 |
| **经营利润** | **$15,955** | **$12,140** | **+31.4%** | financial_statements.txt 第 13 行 |
| **经营利润率** | **40.6%** | — | 同比基本持平 | transcript.txt 第 26299 位（"operating margins…were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%"） |
| 毛利率 | 57.1% | — | — | 见本文计算 |

### 3.2 增长驱动因素（引用原文）

> **Azure and other cloud services**：来自 press_release.txt 第 2 行："Azure and other cloud services revenue increased 43%." 以及 transcript.txt 第 24546 位："In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."
>
> **On-premises server**：来自 transcript.txt 第 24546 位："In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."
>
> **毛利率下降原因**：来自 transcript.txt 第 24546 位："Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure."
>
> **经营费用**：来自 transcript.txt 第 24546 位："Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier."
>
> **经营利润**：来自 transcript.txt 第 24546 位："Operating income grew 31% and operating margins, with a strong focus on efficiencies and investment returns, were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%."

**小结**：Intelligent Cloud 是本季收入增长最快（+32%）且体量最大的分部。Azure 43% 的高增长继续领跑，但成本端增长更快（+42.5%），毛利率被 Azure 销售结构变化和 AI 基础设施前置投入挤压。经营利润率维持在约 41%，规模足以覆盖投资，展现出"投资换增长"的特征。Amy Hood 在电话会中明确指出："customer demand continues to exceed available capacity"，需求强劲是核心驱动。

---

## 四、分部 C：More Personal Computing（更多个人计算）

### 4.1 关键财务指标

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | 同比变化（GAAP） | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | $12,854 | $13,451 | **-4%**（CC -5%） | press_release.txt 第 3 行；financial_statements.txt 第 17 行 |
| 营业成本 | $5,660 | $6,127 | -7.6% | financial_statements.txt 第 18 行 |
| 经营费用 | $4,446 | $4,134 | +7.5% | financial_statements.txt 第 19 行 |
| **经营利润** | **$2,748** | **$3,190** | **-13.9%** | financial_statements.txt 第 20 行 |
| **经营利润率** | **21.4%** | — | 同比下降 | transcript.txt 第 27662 位（"operating margins decreased year-over-year to 21%"） |
| 毛利率 | 56.0% | — | 同比上升 | 见本文计算 |

### 4.2 下滑驱动因素（引用原文）

> **Windows OEM and Devices**：来自 press_release.txt 第 3 行："Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7%." 以及 transcript.txt 第 26953 位："Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7% and Windows OEM decreased 5% driven by lower PC market demand and a high prior-year comparable that benefited from Windows 10 end of support. Results were ahead of expectations as OEM and channel partners continued to build inventory given increasing component prices."
>
> **Search advertising（剔除 TAC）**：来自 press_release.txt 第 3 行："Search advertising revenue excluding traffic acquisition costs increased 10% (up 9% in constant currency)." 驱动来自 transcript.txt 第 26953 位："growth driven by higher revenue per search across Edge and Bing, as well as higher volume, though growth was impacted by third-party partnerships."
>
> **XBOX content and services**：来自 press_release.txt 第 3 行："XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10%." 以及 transcript.txt 第 27662 位："XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10% against a prior-year comparable that benefited from strong first-party content performance."
>
> **毛利率上升**：来自 transcript.txt 第 27662 位："Segment gross margin dollars decreased 2% and gross margin percentage increased year-over-year driven by lower amortization from the Activision acquisition."
>
> **经营费用上升**：来自 transcript.txt 第 27662 位："Operating expenses increased 8% and 7% in constant currency driven by the continued investments in shared R&D noted earlier as well as impairment charges in XBOX."
>
> **经营利润率下降**：来自 transcript.txt 第 27662 位："Operating income decreased 14% and 15% in constant currency and operating margins decreased year-over-year to 21%."

**小结**：More Personal Computing 是唯一出现收入下滑的分部，主要拖累因素是 PC 市场需求疲软和 Windows 10 EoS 高基数效应。XBOX 内容和服务也下滑 10%，管理层明确指出正在进行业务重组（"making the necessary decisions required across our content portfolio, platform, and operations to reset the business for long-term growth"，Satya Nadella 第 40000 位附近）。不过搜索引擎广告（+10%）和毛利率（受 Activision 摊销下降带动）形成部分对冲。经营利润率降至 21%，是三个分部中最低的。

---

## 五、分部完整对比表

| 指标 | Productivity & Business Processes | Intelligent Cloud | More Personal Computing | 合计 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **Q4 FY26 收入** | $37,847 | $39,306 | $12,854 | **$90,007** |
| **Q4 FY25 收入** | $33,112 | $29,878 | $13,451 | **$76,441** |
| **收入 YoY (GAAP)** | +14% | +32% | -4% | +18% |
| **收入 YoY (CC)** | +14% | +31% | -5% | +17% |
| **Q4 FY26 营业成本** | $6,989 | $16,876 | $5,660 | **$29,525** |
| **Q4 FY25 营业成本** | $6,042 | $11,845 | $6,127 | **$24,014** |
| **营业成本 YoY** | +15.7% | +42.5% | -7.6% | +22.9% |
| **Q4 FY26 经营费用** | $8,958 | $6,475 | $4,446 | **$19,879** |
| **Q4 FY25 经营费用** | $8,077 | $5,893 | $4,134 | **$18,104** |
| **经营费用 YoY** | +10.9% | +9.9% | +7.5% | +9.8% |
| **Q4 FY26 经营利润** | $21,900 | $15,955 | $2,748 | **$40,603** |
| **Q4 FY25 经营利润** | $18,993 | $12,140 | $3,190 | **$34,323** |
| **经营利润 YoY** | +15.3% | +31.4% | -13.9% | +18.3% |
| **经营利润率** | 57.9% | 40.6% | 21.4% | 45.1% |
| **毛利率** | 81.5% | 57.1% | 56.0% | 67.2% |

> **注**：合计行经营利润率 = 40,603 / 90,007 = 45.1%；三个分部经营利润率按收入加权平均 = (21,900+15,955+2,748)/90,007 = 45.1%，一致。

---

## 六、口径提示（使用这些数字时必须注意的事项）

1. **分部与合计的口径一致性**：本报告使用的分部收入、成本、经营费用、经营利润数据来自 financial_statements.txt 的 "Segment Results" 工作表和 press_release.txt 的 revenue table。四个勾稽项（收入、COGS、OpEx、Operating Income）均验证完全一致，差异为 0。

2. **分部经营利润率 ≠ 公司整体经营利润率**：公司整体经营利润率（45.1%）是加权平均值，不能简单取三个分部利润率的算术平均（即 (57.9% + 40.6% + 21.4%) / 3 = 39.97% 是错误的）。正确计算方式是 Σ(分部经营利润) / Σ(分部收入) = 40,603 / 90,007 = 45.1%。

3. **毛利率与经营利润率的口径差异**：
   - 毛利率 = (收入 − 营业成本) / 收入，仅扣直接成本；
   - 经营利润率 = 经营利润 / 收入，已扣 R&D + S&M + G&A；
   - 各分部毛利率（81.5% / 57.1% / 56.0%）不可与公司整体毛利率（67.2%）直接比较，因为分部间成本归集范围不同（例如分部 COGS 不含全公司分摊的 R&D/S&M/G&A）。

4. **Cost of Revenue 的分部归属**：财务状态表（financial_statements.txt）按 "Product" 和 "Service and other" 列示成本和收入，再按分部归集。**该 COGS 仅含与分部收入直接对应的成本**，不含全公司层面的共享基础设施投入。因此三个分部 COGS 之和等于公司 COGS 总额。

5. **Operating Expenses 的共享性质**：R&D、S&M、G&A 在 press_release.txt 和 financial_statements.txt 中按分部归集（Segment Results），但存在跨分部共享项目（例如 Azure 的 R&D 也可能部分计入 Productivity & Business Processes）。transcript 中 Amy Hood 多次提到"shared R&D investments"，但具体分摊未单独披露。

6. **同比比较的基准期**：本报告所有同比比较均为与 FY25 Q4（即 2025 财年 Q4，截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日）比较。transcript 中所有增长比较均遵循此口径。

7. **Constant Currency 口径**：CC 同比使用 prior period 的平均汇率将非美元实体重算为美元后再比较。例如 Intelligent Cloud GAAP 收入同比 +32%，CC 同比 +31%，差额（1pp）来自汇率影响。

8. **non-GAAP 与 OpenAI 调整**：本报告所有分部数字均为 GAAP Reported 口径，**未**剔除 OpenAI 投资影响。press_release.txt 中的 non-GAAP 表格调整了总收入和净利润（OpenAI 影响为 Q4 +$480M 净利润、+$0.07 EPS），但**分部层面的 OpenAI 调整未单独披露**，因此分部数据均不含此项调整。

9. **One-time items 的影响**：本季包含 $3.2B Anthropic 投资收益和 XBOX impairment charges，这些均包含在 GAAP 数字中。transcript 第 25346 位："Several discrete items impacted our financial results…resulting in a benefit of $0.27 on diluted EPS." 这些一次性项目影响的是公司整体 EPS 和净利润，对分部收入和经营利润的影响未在分部层面详细拆分，但 transcript 明确提到 XBOX impairment charges 推高了 More Personal Computing 的经营费用。

10. **FY27 展望的口径变化**：Amy Hood 在电话会第 29300 位提到，自 FY27 起始日起，将数据中心和办公楼的使用年限从 15 年延长至 25 年。这一折旧年限调整影响的是 FY27 起的财务费用和 CapEx 分类（finance lease → operating lease），对本报告的 FY26 Q4 历史数据无影响。

---

## 七、结论速览

- **Intelligent Cloud**（收入 $39.3B，+32% YoY）继续以 Azure 43% 增长为引擎，是本季最大亮点，但 AI 基础设施投入使毛利率承压（57.1%，同比下降）。
- **Productivity & Business Processes**（收入 $37.8B，+14% YoY）由 Copilot 驱动 ARPU 提升，经营利润率扩张至 57.9%，是利润率最高的分部。
- **More Personal Computing**（收入 $12.9B，-4% YoY）是唯一下滑分部，PC 需求疲软和 Windows 10 EoS 高基数是主因，经营利润率降至 21.4%。
- 公司整体收入 $90.0B（+18%），经营利润 $40.6B（+18%），经营利润率 45.1%，四个勾稽项完全一致。

所有数字均可逐项在 `press_release.txt`、`financial_statements.txt`（Segment Results 工作表）、`transcript.txt`（Amy Hood 分部评论段落）和 `metrics.txt`（季度指标）中复核。
